A weekly daily average needs weekend rainfall or a five-day denominator; the key silently uses five.
The egg quantities can be read per person or collectively; the key assumes collective counts.
Times more has two conventional readings; no explicit additive or multiplicative definition.
Removing shampoo from a mixed bottle also removes hot sauce; the key retains all previously added sauce without stating separation.
Times more has two conventional readings; no explicit additive or multiplicative definition.
Three times older is inconsistent with common three-times-as-old reading; the key uses four times age.
Mean per-bag percentage and pooled kernel percentage differ; weighting is not specified.
Equal alternating bids and whether the initial bid is counted are unstated.
The stated car counts imply 120 dogs after selling from 90 dogs; constraints contradict.
The dosing window does not specify whether both endpoints are counted; key chooses three doses.
Eight brown candies in the third and fourth bags can mean each or combined.
Increased three times does not unambiguously define final multiplier versus additive increase.
Times more and converting workweeks to a month both require unstated conventions.
Three times older versus three times as old changes the age equation.
The third guess is 200 less than itself, a contradiction.
Running, playing and barking categories are not stated to be disjoint.

The second spending fraction can apply to original earnings or the remaining money.
Other pairwise intersections and inclusion of the three-way overlap in the pairwise count are unspecified.
Thirty-nine cars can mean all cars or front-lot cars; key assumes front lot.
Lisa and Leslie are different names; the necessary shared-person assumption is unstated.
Strict mean above 75 requires absent score above 27, not 27; integer-score minimum would be 28.
Salary and allowance increases may overlap; key assumes disjoint categories.
Month length and whether the stated 20 members include Reese are unspecified.
Times more has two conventional readings; no explicit additive or multiplicative definition.
Using decorative candles does not establish removal from the room; key counts unused candles.

McClure hosts several named programs; the question does not select a unique series or cast.

limitations: Review is a complete row census with mechanistic pooling and all-corpus retrieval support; it is not manual inspection of every one of the 997578 possible row pairs.
No second independent reviewer or model pretraining provenance is available. Public benchmark exposure cannot be ruled out.
Mechanism taxonomy is judgmental. Report source-level and cross-family stress groupings as sensitivity, not new independent observations.
Exclusions and regrouping may empty family/split cells. Do not refill from previously exposed rows or claim a powered five-family test.
No model performance outcomes informed review. No provider calls or native tau2 adapter were added.
Full semantic correctness of all source answer keys and every possible code input is not certified by this independence review.
pooling_rule: Within each workload family, pool the same manually classified mechanism after explicit alias normalization; preserve every v1 component and take transitive closure. This is conservative solution-template grouping, not proof of dependence. Components touching legacy rows are development-only. Cross-family components are excluded rather than passed to a family-independent bootstrap.

Compare prior stable uniqueness and sliding windows: recency-changing hits and eviction order require cache state absent from those set/average templates.
Compare topological layers and new shortest paths: mutual reachability partitions cycles rather than rejecting cycles or optimizing a distance.
Compare old lexicographic grid walk and topological layers: weighted path relaxation has a distinct objective and state from either.
Compare shortest paths and new stable matching: residual capacities and conservation optimize throughput; preference stability and shortest distance are different solution structures.
Compare palindrome edit count and wildcard match: global minimum alignment allows insertions and deletions; mirrored mismatch counting and Boolean wildcard acceptance cannot be reused as its solver.
Compare triangle area, matrix coordinate sort and new perspective division: ordered geometric envelope via orientation is distinct from a scalar area or projecting each point independently.
Compare old run-length codec: adaptive phrase dictionary emits across nonconsecutive repeats; run segmentation and counts cannot implement LZW.
Compare escaped delimiters, prefix filtering and new edit distance: variable-width wildcard acceptance over the full input is distinct from token splitting and minimum-cost edit alignment.

Compare old expression evaluation and new breaker recovery: branch targets, mutable registers and fuel produce general instruction control flow; neither arithmetic expression evaluation nor a fixed breaker transition table is its solution.
Compare max flow and scheduling: preference-ranked deferred acceptance with rejection chains differs from capacity or prerequisite feasibility.
Compare old recursive overlay, validation and multipart envelopes: continued physical lines reconstruct a logical value; no recursive merge, schema partition or multipart body framing is required.
Compare binary string XOR, radix rendering, network blocks and endian decode: per-position permission-bit projection is not XOR between strings, prefix range calculation or signed integer decoding.
POOL with chunked_payload: length-prefixed cursor advancement, payload extraction, termination and truncation rejection are shared despite different length encodings and delimiters.
Compare old literal substitution, style runs and pen plotter: cursor overwrite with nondeleting CR/BS differs from substring replacement, adjacent-run segmentation and planar movement.
Compare old nested JSON patch and literal substitution: positional hunks verified against immutable original coordinates with all-or-nothing context acceptance require a different edit protocol.
Compare old CSV join/filter and matrix coordinate sorting: fixed axis exchange preserves every cell without relational matching, filtering or coordinate selection.

Compare fenced-heading extraction and continued config: header/body sections and boundary termination are a distinct grammar; heading extraction only tracks fenced visibility. No assertion that all parsers have independent errors.
Compare escaped delimiters and literal substitution: formula-risk prefix guarding preserves the original whole cell; it does not tokenize escaped separators or replace matched substrings.
Compare permission bits and radix conversion: address-prefix mask plus complement determine network extrema; per-octal-digit flags and numeral rendering do not solve this contract.

Compare alphabet transforms, UTF-8 and transport text: NFC canonical composition differs from encoded-byte validity, fixed substitutions or ASCII case transforms. Familiar Unicode examples remain a pretraining risk.
Compare elapsed-clock and piecewise-rate arithmetic: enumerate multiple inverse mappings of a discontinuous clock, including missing/ambiguous local times; no single duration/rate answer suffices.

Compare predicate filtering and universal thresholds: explicit Kleene truth tables preserve unknown rather than Boolean inclusion decisions. Primitive Boolean operations alone are not a dependence edge.
Compare modular arithmetic and maximum selection: half-range cyclic order has ambiguity and wraparound, unlike ordinary order or modular exponentiation/product.
Compare old route-distance sums and terminal cursor: evolving heading determines signed 2D position and extents; a scalar distance sum or one-line overwrite cannot solve it.
Compare chronological override, inventory and new OR-set: transaction buffering and atomic commit/abort visibility are distinct from last-message overwrite and tag tombstones.
Compare logical/topological scheduling and token bucket: queue-local credits, head-of-line service and round progression differ from precedence constraints and time-based admission.

Compare latest-per-key and quorum witness: term-qualified majority replication establishes an index; selecting a latest record or showing quorum-set intersection does not implement majority acknowledgement by log prefix.
Compare latest timestamps and predicate filtering: componentwise vector-clock partial order must distinguish concurrency from equality and before; scalar recency cannot do so.

Compare replicated commit and old combinatorial/group-algebra rows: disjoint-set witness for arbitrary read/write subsets establishes intersection guarantee, distinct from a concrete replicated-prefix count.
Compare old set uniqueness and journal: persistent observed-tag tombstones with out-of-order adds and concurrent surviving tags are material new state, not simple duplicate removal.
Compare new SCC and finite-state simulations: language-equivalence partition refinement is different from reachability, graph cycles and executing one event trace.
Compare LZW/run-length/block-cyclic decode: global sorted-rotation reconstruction of BWT differs from dictionary compression, run expansion or fixed-position character cycling.

Compare old stable argmin and LZW: weighted prefix-tree construction and code assignment are distinct from single argmin selection and adaptive phrase dictionaries. Generic sorting is not treated as a template edge.
Compare word sorting and integer covering: ordered contiguous line segmentation with last-line exception and slack-squared objective differs from choosing unordered subsets/coin counts.

Compare bounded binary search, topological layers and SCC: insertion changes a tree through balance-driven rotations; lookup in a static sorted array and graph partitioning have no shared required solver.
Compare inventory replenishment/bounded transfer and journal: ID-specific reserve/commit/cancel transitions with replay rejection are the core, not a reorder quantity or transaction write visibility.

Compare batch ceiling and matrix-index arithmetic: sequential alignment at field-specific moduli plus final structure alignment differs from a single homogeneous capacity ceiling. Rounding primitives alone are not a dependence edge.
Compare bounded inventory transfer and deficit scheduler: refill at elapsed time capped at capacity plus reject-without-consumption differs from static transfer totals and queue-round service.

Compare token admission and instruction machine: consecutive-failure trip, cooldown, half-open probe and recovery depend on outcomes; token accounting and general interpreted branches are different contracts.

Compare old deployment readiness and semantic version reference: root/transitive finite range constraints require global assignment, not checking existing flags or recalling compatible version rules. Versions are explicit integer ranges.
Compare radix rendering, binary XOR and permission bits: byte-order interpretation with signed two-complement adjustment is a different representation contract.

Compare length framing, radix conversion and UTF-8: continuation bits accumulate a variable-length integer followed by zigzag/delta reconstruction; payload-length cursor slicing and scalar-character decoding are distinct.
Compare record validation/migration: type-lattice joins across a column with bool/int distinction differ from rejecting rows or applying a known field schema.

Compare file manifest, contact deduplication and reservations: many names alias persistent inode identity, and reclamation occurs on last unlink; content deduplication and reserved quantities cannot substitute.

Compare record filtering/URL path audit: tuple equivalence after scheme/host/default-port normalization is a different specific predicate from prior column or substring filters; produces comparison booleans rather than filtered records.
Compare convex hull and area tasks: camera-space depth division and axis inversion are pointwise projection, not an orientation/envelope or polygon-area calculation.

Compare topological layers and replenishment: changing multi-resource availability after hypothetical process completion determines safety; static dependency edges and reorder targets do not solve it.
Compare nested lookup/overlay and package constraints: substitution propagation with occurs-check on recursive symbolic terms differs from fetching or merging keys and finite version assignment.

Compare matrix transposition and scalar recurrences: simultaneous local neighbor transition across a 2D lattice differs from axis permutation and a one-dimensional scalar recurrence. Public Game-of-Life familiarity remains a limitation.

Compare decimal money rounding and prefix sums: error feedback makes each later quantization depend on previous residual; independent decimal rounding and accumulated totals do not implement the recurrence.

Compare logical scheduling and alternating extrema sorting: directional nearest service pivots around current head and reverses only after exhausting a side; no prerequisite relation or alternating extrema rule is shared.
